bloom.en: In fact, it's vital. You might recognise some of those voices, including actors Orlando Bloom and Keira Knightley and businessman Richard Branson.
bloom.zh: 事实上，这至关重要。你可能会认出其中的一些声音，包括演员 Orlando Bloom 和 Keira Knightley，以及企业家 Richard Branson。

bloom.en: But people in a procedural culture would say something like, “after the rain stops” or “when a specific flower blooms”, or “when the river is dry”.
bloom.zh: 程序时间是对真实事件、真实事物的反应，而不是对抽象概念的反应。

blink.en: The idiom the blink of an eye means a very short period of time.
blink.zh: 习语“眨眼之间”的意思是极短的一段时间。

blink.en: In geological time, even a 10,000-year-old civilisation is the blink of an eye – an idiom meaning a very short period of time.
blink.zh: 在地质时间里，即使是一个存在了1万年的文明，也不过是“眨眼之间”——一个意为极短时间的习语。

blink.en: A data centre is, essentially, a giant warehouse full of computers, tens of thousands of them, all stacked up in metal racks, blinking away, processing and storing data.
blink.zh: 数据中心本质上是一个摆满计算机的巨大仓库，里面有几万台计算机，全都在金属架上层层叠叠地码好，一闪一闪地处理和存储数据。

blaze.en: The idiom, with all guns blazing, describes doing things with lots of energy and enthusiasm.
blaze.zh: 成语“大张旗鼓”，形容做事充满精力和热情。

blaze.en: It's a mistake to try to declutter everything all at once, with all guns blazing – an idiom meaning to do things dramatically, with lots of energy and enthusiasm.
blaze.zh: 试图一下子把所有东西都清理干净是一个错误，这叫“大张旗鼓”——一个成语，意思是用极大的精力和热情轰轰烈烈地做事。

blind.en: Being blind to something means failing to notice it or recognise it as a threat.
blind.zh: 对某事视而不见意味着未能注意到它或没有将它识别为威胁。

blind.en: His hair had been shaved off, he was hooked up with tubes, he was blind and deaf.
blind.zh: 他的头发被剃光了，身上插满了各种管子，双目失明，双耳失聪。

blind.en: Hannibal himself is said to have gone blind in one eye from an infection during the crossing.
blind.zh: 据说Hannibal本人在翻越山脉期间也因感染导致一只眼睛失明。

blind.en: By this point, he was old, blind, and partially deaf.
blind.zh: 到了这个时候，他已经年迈、双目失明且部分失聪。

blind.en: They would be consumed by flesh-eating maggots or larvae, they would be blinded by little worms, there were all manner of diseases and threats that killed or crippled his travelling companions.
blind.zh: 他们会被食肉蛆虫或幼虫侵蚀，会被小虫子弄瞎双眼，有各种各样的疾病和威胁杀死了或致残了他的同伴。

blush.en: What was the voice? Hello? Oh dear. But embarrassment is more than just shyness and blushing.
blush.zh: 那是怎样的语气？哈喽？哦天哪。但尴尬不仅仅是害羞和脸红。

blush.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Beth. Lots of things can make us feel embarrassed – that self-conscious, uncomfortable feeling when your face blushes red and you wish you could just disappear.
blush.zh: 我是尼尔。我是贝斯。许多事情都会让我们感到尴尬——那种自我意识过强、浑身不自在的感觉，当你的脸涨得通红，恨不得找个地缝钻进去。

blast.en: Shotgun blasts hit his left arm. He survived, but his arm was permanently disabled.
blast.zh: 霰弹枪击中了他的左臂，他保住了性命，但左臂从此终身残废。

blast.en: So, the ground is shaking, music is blasting, and thousands of fans are dancing.
blast.zh: 所以，地面在震动，音乐在轰鸣，成千上万的粉丝在跳舞。

blast.en: After all, it's almost more surprising that the blast didn’t kill Hitler.
blast.zh: 毕竟，爆炸居然没能炸死希特勒，这几乎更让人感到意外。

blast.en: And if Hitler had been killed in the blast, it seems highly probable that Operation Valkyrie would have proceeded as it was intended.
blast.zh: 而且，如果希特勒在爆炸中身亡，“瓦尔基里行动”极有可能按原计划顺利进行。

blast.en: In other words, yes, you might think of a rocket blasting off into space and think, “Well, that must be very environmentally unfriendly”, but it is approximately 700 times better for the environment than the way we currently do it.
blast.zh: 换句话说，是的，你可能会想到火箭呼啸着飞向太空，然后觉得“嗯，这一定很不环保”，但它对环境的友好程度大约是我们目前开采方式的 700 倍。

bleed.en: The bleeding, the purging, the blistering, these would have weakened him physically.
bleed.zh: 放血、泻药、起泡剂，这些都会在肉体上削弱他。

bleed.en: They start by bleeding him. They give him laxatives and emetics, medicines designed to make him vomit.
bleed.zh: 他们首先给他放血。他们给他吃泻药和催吐剂，这些药物旨在让他呕吐。

bleed.en: Your fingertips would crack and bleed. And it never ended.
bleed.zh: 你的指尖会开裂、流血。而且永无止境。

bless.en: The working-class champion needed the billionaire's blessing to get through the door.
bless.zh: 这位工人阶级的斗士需要亿万富翁的祝福才能敲开这扇大门。

bless.en: It means to reveal a secret. And if something is a “blessing in disguise “, it might seem bad at first, but it actually leads to something good.
bless.zh: 它的意思是泄露秘密。如果某事是“blessing in disguise”，它一开始可能看起来是件坏事，但实际上会带来好结果。

bless.en: On the 6th of July 1975, he stood before the Comorian parliament and declared independence, unilaterally, without waiting for France's blessing.
bless.zh: 1975年7月6日，他站在科摩罗议会面前，单方面宣布独立，根本没有等待法国的批准。

bless.en: And there’s more. Water use might be a non-issue in the wet and rainy country of Scotland, but in countries less blessed by constant showers and flowing rivers, it is.
bless.zh: 不仅如此。在湿润多雨的苏格兰，水资源利用可能不是个问题，但在那些没有经常下雨和流淌河流眷顾的国家里，它就是个问题。

bleak.en: It was bleak, uncompromising, and fiercely argued.
bleak.zh: 它悲观、毫不妥协且论证激烈。

bleak.en: From details about the mechanics of washing clothes right through to the daily struggle to get enough money to feed their families, it shone a light on the bleak reality of life in industrial towns and cities.
bleak.zh: 从洗衣服的具体细节，到为挣够养家糊口的钱而日夜挣扎，这本书揭露了工业城镇里暗淡的生活现实。

blame.en: When things get more difficult in a country, people often blame immigration.
blame.zh: 当一个国家的情况变得更加困难时，人们往往会归咎于移民。

blame.en: A series of apartment bombings in Russia killed over 300 people, and the government blamed Chechen rebels.
blame.zh: 俄罗斯发生了一系列公寓爆炸案，导致300多人丧生，政府将此归咎于车臣叛军。

blame.en: Accusing them could settle scores or shift blame.
blame.zh: 指控她们可以了结恩怨或者转移责备。

blame.en: He was a talented general and a proud Carthaginian, and, perhaps reasonably, he blamed Rome for all of this.
blame.zh: 他是一位才华横溢的将军，也是一个骄傲的迦太基人，或许也算合情合理，他将这一切都归咎于罗马。

blame.en: These bombings, which the government blamed on Chechen rebels, provided the justification for Putin’s launch of the Second Chechen War, a brutal military campaign to bring the region back under Russian control.
blame.zh: 政府将这些爆炸案归咎于车臣叛军，这为普京发动第二次车臣战争提供了借口，这是一场旨在将该地区重新置于俄罗斯控制之下的残酷军事行动。

blend.en: They could pose as Silk Road customers, or even sellers, blending into the marketplace like anyone else.
blend.zh: 他们可以伪装成 The Silk Road 的顾客，甚至是卖家，像其他人一样融入这个市场。

blend.en: So “broligarchy” is a blend of “bro” and “oligarchy”.
blend.zh: 所以“富豪兄弟会”（broligarchy）就是“兄弟”和“寡头政治”的结合体。

blend.en: Istanbul is famous for its blend of East and West.
blend.zh: 伊斯坦布尔以其东西方融合而闻名。
它是“兄弟”（bro）或“兄弟主义”（broism）与“寡头政治”（oligarchy）的混合词。

blend.en: One key technique he used was Sfumato, which is a method of softly blending colors and tones so that there are no sharp lines.
blend.zh: 他使用的关键技术之一是晕涂法（Sfumato），这是一种柔和地融合颜色和色调、使画面没有生硬线条的方法。

blunt.en: Some economists argue that a blanket minimum wage is a blunt tool, like trying to tend to a flowerbed with a lawnmower instead of precise little scissors.
blunt.zh: 一些经济学家认为，一刀切的最低工资是一种笨拙的工具，就像试图用割草机而不是精细的小剪刀来打理花坛一样。

blossom.en: Fountains in Versailles were filled with orange blossom water, and royal furniture was sprayed with lavender and rose extracts.
blossom.zh: 凡尔赛宫的喷泉里注满了橙花水，皇家家具上喷洒了薰衣草和玫瑰提取物。

blur.en: The line between reality and the roles they were playing had become dangerously blurred.
blur.zh: 现实与他们所扮演角色之间的界限，已经模糊到了危险的地步。

blur.en: Over time this has blurred the line between journalism, entertainment, and opinion.
blur.zh: 久而久之，这模糊了新闻业、娱乐业和观点表达之间的界限。

blur.en: In short, broligarchy highlights the blurred lines, the burred division, between tech companies and politics, especially in the USA.
blur.zh: 简而言之，“富豪兄弟会”凸显了科技公司与政治之间日益模糊的界限和分歧，尤其是在美国。

blur.en: In today’s episode, we’re going to explore what it means to live in a post-truth society…. a society where the line between fact and opinion is increasingly blurred, and where it can feel harder than ever to know what is real.
blur.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将探讨生活在一个后真相社会意味着什么……在这个社会里，事实与观点的界限日益模糊，而要知道什么是真实的，也比以往任何时候都更让人感到困难。
